summary:
Complete Android Jetpack Compose source code file (LpgMainApp.kt) for LPG Manager featuring:
- High-contrast Material 3 dark navy UI with zero non-English strings
- Role-based views for Admin and Delivery Staff
- Stock tracking for 14.2 KG Domestic, 19 KG Commercial, and 5 KG Chhotu cylinders (Full, Empty, and Defective)
- End-of-Day (EOD) Staff Cash and Empty Tally Reconciliation UI
- Quarantined Defective Cylinder Bay for bottling plant warranty exchanges
- 19 KG Commercial Customer Credit & Rolling Empty Ledger
- One-Click EOD Summary Report and WhatsApp Receipt generation hooks
